errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.UNKNOWN_ERROR: Verba cannot complete the translation right now. Please try again later.
errors.INVALID_API_KEY: Your API key is invalid. Check it and try again.
errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: You don’t have permission to use this provider.
errors.INSUFFICIENT_QUOTA: Your API account has insufficient quota. Please check billing.
errors.MODEL_UNAVAILABLE: No compatible model is available. Check models again.

errors.PROVIDER_NETWORK_ERROR: Verba could not reach the AI provider. Check your network and try again.
errors.PROVIDER_RATE_LIMIT: Requests are temporarily rate-limited across the available models. Please try again later.
errors.PROVIDER_QUOTA_ERROR: Your API account has insufficient quota. Please check billing.

errors.MODEL_NOT_FOUND: The selected model is unavailable. Check models again.
errors.MODEL_OUTPUT_INVALID: The AI provider returned an invalid translation format. Please try again.
errors.JSON_PARSE_FAILED: The AI response could not be parsed. Please try again.
errors.ENTITY_RESTORE_FAILED: Protected terms could not be restored, so Verba did not return a potentially incorrect translation.
errors.ENTITY_VALIDATION_FAILED: The translation did not pass protected-term validation. Please try again.
errors.SEMANTIC_VALIDATION_FAILED: The translation contains a clear critical fact or participant-role error, so Verba did not return it.
errors.TRANSLATION_EMPTY: The AI provider returned an empty translation. Please try again.
errors.LOCAL_SERVER_ERROR: The local translation service failed. Restart Verba and try again.
